body:
We actually don't need this file, unless we use the `icon` field: https://docs.pkgforge.dev/sbuild/specification/12.icon
I keep these for our pkgs.pkgforge.dev website & other metadata

If an `SBUILD` has single `provides`, then a default.png or default.svg is enough
If there's many provides then sure we will add files like this
We should make it `appimage.official.stable.yaml` instead of `appimage.stable.yaml` as this `SBUILD` uses officially provided binary

body:
This is perfectly okay,
but homebrew has a neat rule that says every project they add must have a license
This is to avoid legal problems

So we can extend this
```yaml
license:
 - id: "GPL-3.0"
   url: "https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/raw/3fafcf4aa9ae3d620ff691cba3a1a2195d592914/LICENSE"
```

I just went to: https://github.com/flameshot-org/flameshot/blob/master/LICENSE
and then copied as permalink and changed `blob` to `raw`

body:
The removal command 'rm -rf "$(realpath .)"' may unintentionally remove more than just the TEMPREPO directory. Consider targeting the TEMPREPO directory explicitly (e.g., 'rm -rf "$(realpath .)/TEMPREPO"') to avoid potential issues.
```suggestion
    [ -d "$(realpath .)/TEMPREPO" ] && rm -rf "$(realpath .)/TEMPREPO" >/dev/null 2>&1 && popd >/dev/null 2>&1
```
